acceptance_criteria: The bounded population is limited to publicly accessible 2024-2025 Texas A&M football availability evidence tied to covered SEC or CFP games, plus the official SEC policy and archive-route captures; no nationwide or earlier-era completeness is claimed.

Every acquired source response, article, report version, source URL, capture timestamp, publication timestamp, evidence excerpt, normalized candidate row, manifest, quarantine row, and validation result is content-addressed outside Git.

Official SEC report evidence outranks timestamped media reproduction when available; an empty or inaccessible official archive is preserved as an explicit provider limitation and never converted into a healthy, available, or complete population inference.

Each candidate preserves season, game, team, player display identity, position when present, status, report version or publication class, published-at, captured-at, source class, exact evidence locator, and source/capture hashes; later revisions never rewrite earlier versions.

Player identities remain source-scoped candidates unless deterministic provider or canonical identity evidence exists; name-only, model-only, roster-only, participation-only, or score-assisted merges are prohibited.

No candidate enters canonical entities, PIT state, training features, protected evaluation, model promotion, forecasts, BAS, Aggie Excess, or publication state until a separate deterministic admission unit proves applicable identity, chronology, coverage, and leakage gates.
ai_context_notes: The official SEC archive shell and public client endpoint are reachable, but the archive endpoint returned an empty JSON array during the bounded 2026-08-11 probe.

Timestamped public reproductions exist for Texas A&M availability-report versions in both 2024 and 2025 and may be retained as lower-authority candidate evidence while the official archive gap is explicit.
Deterministic extraction is preferred for structured tables; governed OpenAI assistance is eligible only for evidence-present ambiguous layouts and remains candidate-only.

Retired assistive-pipeline Local Issue IDs previously linked here are recorded in jira/reconciliation/BAT_RETIRED_CANONICAL_ISSUE_REGISTRY.json and now live in BATQ; they are not active BAT parents, dependencies, or expected board links.
definition_of_done: A deterministic acquisition adapter captures the SEC policy, official archive shell, official archive API response, and a bounded source registry of timestamped 2024-2025 Texas A&M availability evidence without exposing embedded or project credentials.

A deterministic builder emits version-preserving player-game-status candidate rows and explicit source, route, report-version, player-identity, coverage, noncoverage, missingness, and chronology dispositions; absence never implies health or availability.

Independent validation checks all source/capture hashes, publication-before-game ordering where claimed, duplicate/version behavior, status vocabulary, player candidate identity, forbidden inferences, mutation controls, and byte-identical replay from the exact immutable captures.
Immutable raw, candidate, quarantine, manifest, and validation payloads are stored under the configured external data root; reconstructible temporary downloads are removed after validation.
Live Jira, goal, active plan, evidence, repository/provenance validators, secret scan, full test suite, normal PR review, post-merge synchronization, and cleanup pass before Done.
end_to_end_validation: Replay the exact bounded immutable source captures independently; verify source URLs, HTTP outcomes, hashes, publication and capture timestamps, game/report-version ordering, normalized player-status candidates, explicit archive noncoverage, no absence-to-health inference, no name-only canonical merge, candidate-only authority, byte-identical rows, and cleanup.
in_scope: Official SEC availability policy and archive-route capture with exact technical outcome and provider limitations.
Bounded 2024-2025 Texas A&M football report-version evidence from public timestamped sources when exact facts are present.
Deterministic extraction, candidate normalization, provenance, coverage/noncoverage, validation, isolated replay, Jira synchronization, and cleanup.
objective: Recover timestamped SEC Texas A&M availability evidence and preserve official archive gaps without inferring healthy status or canonical player identity.
out_of_scope: Inferring healthy, available, injured, or absent from missing reports, missing names, roster membership, participation, press-conference language, or game outcomes.

Treating lower-authority media reproduction as an official archive payload or silently filling report versions, publication times, positions, identities, statuses, or games absent from cited evidence.
Canonical/PIT/training/protected admission, champion or production promotion, forecast publication, final historical readiness, protected A&M lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or any scientific claim.
prerequisites: TASK-191 availability report version and policy-scope PIT contract is Done with verified evidence.
TASK-193 official conference availability source lane and A&M SEC priority is Done with verified evidence.
Configured standardized external data root, safe isolated worktree, and successful live Jira authentication.
required_evidence: Exact official policy, archive shell, archive API, fallback source, raw capture, normalized candidate, quarantine, manifest, validation, deterministic replay, and cleanup hashes.

Sources, games, report versions, publication timestamps, player-status rows, statuses, positions, identity dispositions, exclusions, missingness, archive failures, and coverage by season and source class.
Repository/provenance/Jira/secret/full-suite validator results, PR and merge identities, live Jira comments/transitions/links, and explicit candidate-only/protected nonclaims.

required_tests.expectation: Official-route emptiness, deterministic structured extraction, report-version ordering, status vocabulary, source-scoped identity, absence-to-UNKNOWN behavior, mutation rejection, and candidate-only authority remain deterministic.
All bounded sources, captures, timestamps, report versions, candidates, negative findings, mutation checks, byte-identical replay, external artifacts, and authority boundaries pass independently.

risk_failure_conditions: Any source URL, capture, publication timestamp, report version, game mapping, player display identity, status, evidence locator, schema, or replay identity drifts or is fabricated.
Any missing report, absent player, inaccessible official route, or lower-authority source is represented as healthy, available, official-complete, or canonical truth.
Any candidate bypasses identity, chronology, PIT, leakage, canonical, training, protected, promotion, or scientific authority gates.
scope: Acquire, normalize, reconcile, and independently coverage-gate a bounded timestamped 2024-2025 Texas A&M SEC availability evidence population while preserving official archive noncoverage and candidate-only authority.
stop_conditions: Stop and quarantine the affected source, report version, or row on source/capture hash, publication time, game mapping, status vocabulary, player identity, evidence locator, schema, chronology, replay, credential, or authority failure.
Preserve valid partial and negative findings and continue unrelated historical expansion and modeling; source-specific failure must not globally block the project.
Do not weaken UNKNOWN missingness, report-version chronology, source authority, identity, PIT, leakage, or protected boundaries to manufacture availability coverage.
title: Recover timestamped SEC Texas A&M availability evidence and preserve archive gaps
why_this_exists: Historical availability remains an explicit GAP-008 domain. The official SEC policy establishes a high-value, timestamped A&M lane beginning in 2024, but the live archive currently returns no historical rows. This unit preserves that limitation and recovers evidence-present report versions from public timestamped routes without inventing health, identity, or completeness.
